sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-220 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, and only SUP-B is approved. There is no approval for Chisone (SUP-C). The 2026-11-06 re-audit restored company standing only and gave no part approval.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP) for a change of source, and 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this change. DEV-127 was rejected, and DEV-118 covers only packaging and has expired.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-220 is drawn in EN AW-6082-T6. The 8D is still open after the 2026-11-06 re-audit.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.
SC-BR220-YS,BR-220,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing requires MAT-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa. Chisone is qualified only for MAT-6061-T6 and MAT-6082-T5. The T5 temper has a typical yield of 230 MPa, below the 250 MPa minimum. Ferri's phone claim of the same alloy as BR-310 refers to 6082-T5.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: Chisone has no 3.1 certificate for MAT-6082-T6. Its certificates cover only 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) should be asked to obtain one.
